I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-random. I said the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, which replaces the date in their #north-team post this morning. I didn't open #north-team to check what that post said. A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat in the channel.

Ilse said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else. I offered to post the correction in #north-team if they want the team to see it, and I'll only do that if they ask.
